# Policymaker #205, iteration 0024, pass 3

Session #207 passed Verification in-session, but the engine epilogue failed at the Git comparison and printed Git usage text ([report](history/sessions/207/179ca9ae0a2b69ff755c608529db12ae30e22a3b7ce4be19bf04d3c9ca72d756.md)).
The exact Git failure cause remains unconfirmed; the saved challenge content is unchanged at `449f3d7`, tag `iter/0024/207`.
Reviewer #208 ended blocked without an available report; no substantive review verdict exists.
[Orders](orders.json) replace the epilogue's Git comparisons with pinned SHA256 checks for all five challenge files and three lineage files.
`finish-landing-207` starts from the saved checkpoint, verifies without Git, changes no repository files and leaves committing to the parent.
Expected gain: the saved landing can pass the engine epilogue and reach main without repeating fixture preparation.
The exact revised Verification exited 0 on an isolated copy of `iter/0024/207` without Git metadata; the order dependencies and required report header also checked successfully.
`review-challenges-207` depends on that landing and independently checks protocol coverage, every evidence pointer, denominators and frozen outcomes.
Expected gain: a documented accept or revise recommendation before scorer work; the reviewer must save an initial report immediately.
[Policy memory](../policy/working-memory.md) records both outcomes and the revised verification method; routing remains unchanged.
Startup diagnostics were within budget; no new access or spending is requested.
Native fidelity, baseline evidence, restricted split allocation, typedef-impact and diagram-difference coverage remain incomplete; product quality is unmeasured.
Passing generation or evidence-index checks establishes neither benchmark readiness nor successful challenge execution. Reader work remains gated.

## Discoveries
Verification passed in-session but failed in the engine epilogue at a Git-dependent check, so verification must also work outside the session's Git context ([report #207](history/sessions/207/179ca9ae0a2b69ff755c608529db12ae30e22a3b7ce4be19bf04d3c9ca72d756.md)).

## What next
On wake, inspect both outcomes, main's evaluator output and the reviewer's actual model usage; remove the one-off landing script only after integration is confirmed.
If review blocks again without a report, investigate its profile and routing before another attempt. Resume the saved checkpoint; avoid manual merges, fixture regeneration and task-side commits.

Waiting for the iteration to continue: then `policy/` merges and the orders start.
